title: Women's 100m World Rankings: October 2026
desc: The top ten in World Athletics' women's 100m event ranking as of 20 October 2026. Ranking scores reflect the governing body's event ranking criteria, not athletes' fastest race times; qualifying performances can include shorter sprints.

source.name: World Athletics — Women’s 100m World Rankings
source.note: Verified by the AllRanks assistant on 2026-10-29 against the linked official World Athletics table: compared all ten names, countries, places and scores, and the 20 October 2026 date. This is a dated top-ten snapshot of the event ranking, not a list of fastest times; the source also includes 50m, 55m and 60m performances. The live table may change.
